description: Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.

d.request: Using fees with feerate >= 0.0009 (cutoff inclusive), inner join to orders on fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault (dropping unmatched fees), group by orderslink and mktnote, and return orderslink, mktnote, AVG(rebrate) and SUM(rebtotal) ignoring NULLs, ordered by total rebate descending with NULLs last, limited to the top 10 with no rounding.
d.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 on the fee rate (`feerate`) as the cutoff, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round. Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

a.request: Take fee records with a fee rate (`feerate`) of at least 0.0009 and match each to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
